pluginDescription: Ships the OpenCode Go provider, a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header and the rolling / weekly / monthly usage
dialog.title: OpenCode Go usage
usage.error.noProvider: No provider points at the OpenCode Go endpoint
usage.error.noKey: The provider has no API key yet
usage.error.badKey: Character {index} of the API key is not ASCII; please paste it again
usage.error.auth: The API key is invalid or expired
usage.error.entitlement: This key has no OpenCode Go subscription
usage.error.network: The request failed or timed out
usage.error.parse: The response could not be parsed
settings.injectProviderTip: Create and maintain the OpenCode Go provider in SiYuan's own AI settings page, where it stays fully editable. Once you delete it by hand the plugin leaves it alone; rebuild it by switching this back on or using Repair now.
settings.repairTip: Fills in missing required headers and endpoint fields and strips blanks/zero width characters from the API key; a deleted provider is rebuilt, and a single existing entry on the same endpoint is adopted instead of duplicated.
settings.repairDone: The provider config has been repaired
settings.refreshModelsTip: Fetch the provider's available models through SiYuan's native model list API.
settings.dynamicSessionTip: When on, every conversation sends its own stable ID, written before the request leaves. When off, the static ID below is used for everything.
settings.staticSessionIdTip: Used when per-conversation sending is off; leave empty to generate an installation level ID.
settings.userAgentModeTip: The official documentation asks clients to identify themselves instead of using a generic SDK name.
settings.customUserAgentTip: Only used when the previous item is set to custom.
settings.inlineUsageTip: Only shown while the OpenCode Go endpoint is in use; click it for the details.
settings.intervalTip: 300 seconds by default, 30 - 3600 allowed; opening the settings page or the detail dialog refreshes once.
settings.refreshNowTip: Query OpenCode Go for the current usage right away.
settings.debugLogTip: Print prefixed diagnostics to the developer console; it never contains the API key.
settings.checkTip: Read-only self check: whether a provider hits the official endpoint, whether the required headers are complete, and the session variable.
check.dismissed: deleted by hand (not recreated automatically; use Repair now to rebuild)
check.apiKeyDirty: holds blanks/zero width characters (chat will be rejected; Repair now strips them)
check.apiKeyNonAscii: character {index} is not ASCII (Repair now strips blanks and zero width characters, the rest has to be pasted again)
message.variableTip: The OPENCODE_GO_SESSION variable in your variable store is maintained by this plugin; please do not delete or rename it.
